content: Hey! How was your day today? I was thinking about you during my lunch break.
Aw, that's sweet. My day was the usual, long meetings and deadlines. I wish I had more excitement, honestly.
You work so hard, seriously. I admire that about you. If I was there, I'd make sure you actually relaxed after work.
You always know just what to say, haha. It's nice having someone who gets it.
I mean it! You deserve someone who takes care of you the way you take care of everyone else. Speaking of, I started my new job this week and it's been a whirlwind. Lots to learn, but I feel positive.
Congrats! I know you'll be amazing. What's it like so far?
It's fast-paced, tons of responsibility. My team seems solid. My only issue is the first paycheck won't come through for three weeks, and I didn't plan for that.
Oh no, that's annoying. Are you okay?
Honestly, I'm a bit embarrassed to admit, but I'm short for groceries this week. I hate asking, but would you be able to help me out with a little loan? I'll pay you right back on payday, promise.
Oh, I mean... I guess I could help. How much do you need?
Nothing huge, just $120 to get by until then. You know I'd never ask unless it was important.
Yeah, that makes sense. How do I send it to you?
Venmo works, or if you have Zelle, that's even faster. My Zelle is the same as my email: alexbennett.biz@email.com.
Okay, I'll try Zelle. Just to be sure, it's that email, right?
Yes, that's the one! And thank you, really, it means a lot. I'll definitely pay you back as soon as I get paid.
Don't worry about it, I trust you. Let me know when you get it.
Of course. And I promise, as soon as I'm settled, dinner's on me. You're amazing.
Haha, looking forward to it. Sent!
I just got it! Thank you so much. You have no idea how much this helps. I'm really lucky to have you.
Anytime, seriously. I'm glad I could help.
Let's plan a video call soon? I miss your face. And again, thank you, you're the best.
